messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> metrics_pipeline_missing_scrapes fired for service=metrics-prod (eu cluster). Autopage: 3 targets affected, severity=high. https://pd.redwood.example/alerts/1745604322 :rotating_light:
maya (on-call): acked. jumping in — grabbing dashboard and logs now.
maya (on-call): first glance: scrape rate for prometheus-exporter-eu down ~95% over last 8m, kafka-ingest lag climbing. not seeing obvious node OOMs.
ben_reyes: thx — are we seeing exporter pods crashloop or just scrape failures?
maya (on-call): exporter's up but returning 503s on /metrics for many targets. curl shows intermittent 502s from scrape-proxy.
tom_s: re: 502 from scrape-proxy — could be upstream timeout to exporter or heavy GC. can someone pull logs from scrape-proxy-ss?
maya (on-call): running: kubectl logs -n observability scrape-proxy-eu-2 --since=10m | tail -n 200
maya (on-call): log snippet: 
```
W 10:12:03 upstream timeout while proxying to exporter-12:5042
E 10:12:04 rate limiter dropping request for tenant=redwood-prod
```
ops_lead: looks like backpressure on the proxy layer. we had a config change for rate-limits yesterday — @ben_reyes any chance that rollout spilled?
ben_reyes: I can check rollout history now: `kubectl rollout history ds/scrape-proxy -n observability --revision`
ben_reyes: hmm, no recent rollouts in eu cluster since last week. rate-limiter config comes from configmap `scrape-proxy-cfg` — pulling it.
ben_reyes: config still has default throttle 200r/s, but current incoming is 1.2k r/s based on ingress metrics. that's why limiter is dropping.
maya (on-call): confirmed ingress spike ~1.2k/s, likely due to a bad scrape-target in eu that started returning large payloads and causing retries.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation in 8m unless acknowledged by secondary on-call `tom_s`.
maya (on-call): taking immediate mitigation: increasing throttle window on scrape-proxy and re-routing heavy targets to /backup-scrape.
Tom_s: I can take over in 15m. if you want me to make the config change, paste the kubectl patch you plan to run.
maya (on-call): plan: `kubectl patch cm scrape-proxy-cfg -n observability --patch '{"data":{"rate_limit":"800"}}' && kubectl rollout restart ds/scrape-proxy -n observability`
ben_reyes: we should avoid full restart if possible — do a hot-config reload: `kubectl exec -n observability scrape-proxy-eu-2 -- /usr/bin/sighup-proxy`
maya (on-call): doing hot reloads across EU nodes now, rolling every 30s.
maya (on-call): applying hot reload to 3/5 proxies — traffic dropback to ~300r/s, errors dropping.
customer-ops: any affected customers yet? we have a ticket queue flagging higher response times for embedded metrics in EU tenant accounts.
maya (on-call): short answer: yes-ish. dashboard shows some synthetic customers experiencing delayed metrics ingest; no full data loss detected yet.
customer-ops: opening SEV-LOW to affected customers advising degraded metrics latency. will escalate if data missing persists.
ben_reyes: while probes are stabilizing, Kafka consumer group for log-ingest has backed up ~250k messages. offsets show consumer `log-ingest-eu` lagging. normalized after proxy throttle drop?
maya (on-call): kafka lag started climbing 10m before the proxy errors. may be related — exporters spamming larger payloads caused both scrape retries and log batching to surge.
tom_s: I'm taking over ops on this. handing off: maya -> tom_s. maya, pls drop any runbook notes in the channel.
maya (on-call): handoff accepted. notes: 1) hot reload scrape-proxy -> reduced 502/503s; 2) identify bad targets: exporter-12 (high payloads) and exporter-18 (flaky); 3) scale up `log-ingest` consumers by +2 replicas to drain backlog: `kubectl scale deployment/log-ingest-eu --replicas=6 -n ingest`. 4) customer-ops notified.
tom_s: executing scale now. `kubectl scale` returns success. monitoring consumer lag.
ops_lead: also patching an emergency rate-limit whitelist for critical scrapes to avoid accidental throttling: adding tenant `payments-prod` to whitelist.
ben_reyes: investigating exporter-12 — heap dump shows spike during large scrape responses, maybe mem leak. will isolate and restart exporter-12 if needed.
incident-bot: PagerDuty ack by maya (on-call) recorded. escalation suppressed.
maya (on-call): restarting exporter-12 now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/exporter-12 -n exporters`
maya (on-call): exporter restarted, health checks passing. sample scrape payload sizes now within normal range.
ben_reyes: kafka lag trending down, from 250k -> 40k in 9m after scaling consumers and proxy fix.
customer-ops: updating status page: "Metrics ingestion experiencing degraded latency in EU region; mitigation in progress. No customer data loss identified"
ops_lead: good. once lag <5k and error rate <1% for 15m we can start recovery steps and close PD incident.
tom_s: continuing to watch. will rotate on-call handover to next shift in 25m.
maya (on-call): adding post-incident TODOs: 1) add exporter memory thresholds and alert on GC pauses; 2) revisit scrape-proxy autoscaling thresholds; 3) add synthetic checks per-tenant to detect heavy payloads earlier.
ben_reyes: filing a follow-up ticket: INF-5421 "investigate exporter-12 mem growth and add synthetic per-tenant checks" and assign to eng-mlobservability.
customer-ops: I'll keep customers updated and close SEV-LOW when metrics latency back to normal.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for now (PD incident suppressed). Reminder: create postmortem within 48h.
ops_lead: thanks team. good rapid mitigation and handoff.
